title: TinyTales
tagline: Tinytales - A kid safe DataDAO based on FEVM. TinyTales represents a new and innovative approach to kids safe content.
description:
TinyTales represents a new and innovative approach to kids safe content, leveraging the latest in blockchain technology to provide a secure and trustworthy environment for children to learn, grow, and connect with others. TinyTales provides a safe and secure environment for children to explore and learn, free from exposure to harmful or inappropriate content.

TinyTales is a data DAO that provides a secure and transparent system for verifying the authenticity and origin of content, ensuring that children are only exposed to safe and approved content.
how_its_made:
The frontend of the project is setup using React/Next.js, backend smart contracts are deployed in Hyperspace Testnet and based on Zondax Filecoin Solidity APIs. All the learning materials are uploaded into IPFS. The CID details are persisted using Filecoin Solidity library.

Tiny Tales DAO members upvote/downvote the content, based on the results the content is made accessible to the consumers.
